objective: Close the standalone datapath path from canonical K4 row folding through a same-address-forwarding signed19 lane accumulator and exact 8x384x96 commit, while repairing the M123 independent review's reset-edge external-write leak at the integration boundary.

lineage.m125_review_p1: reset-high standalone M125 exposed fill, row and update handshakes that were subsequently discarded by the synchronous reset branch
lineage.m123_review_p1: synchronous reset did not isolate ready/accept or a pending physical lane-memory write
lineage.m126_repair: gate every external handshake, commit, lane-memory enable and fold-to-accumulator transfer while reset is asserted; do not alter the reset-free M125 fold or M123 forwarding datapaths

architecture.same_row_path: M125 canonical select-and-clear updates are accepted consecutively by M123; undefined same-address macro reads are suppressed and the just-computed signed19 vector is forwarded
architecture.numeric_semantics: exact signed addition with no saturation or rounding
architecture.reset_semantics: an accepted but not yet physically written update is explicitly cancelled when reset is asserted

directed_positive_scope.ratio_scope: synthetic directed traffic compression only; not a cycle, physical or system speedup

reset_attack_scope.interpretation: reset cancels the in-flight operation; this is isolation, not persistence or retry

cycle_evidence_boundary.admission: projection only; M126 VCS proves functional realizability and conservation but does not measure either ratio

paper_safe_statement: Commercial VCS verifies a standalone K4-fold-to-forwarding-accumulator datapath across all 8x384 destinations: 24,802 directed signed source contributions become 7,326 accepted accumulator updates and exactly 7,326 lane writes, followed by 294,912 exact commit-lane checks. A reset-edge attack produces no visible handshake or physical write. The 3.385x directed traffic ratio and the separate 3.17x held-out fixed8 service-island projection are not physical or system speedups.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim that the behavioral weight cache or accumulator lane memories are foundry macros.
Do not describe the 3.385476385476 directed source-to-update ratio as latency, throughput, energy or system speedup.
Do not attribute the M122 3.1725369008459166 projection to M126 VCS measurement.
Do not claim reset persistence or retry; reset intentionally cancels the pending operation.
Do not claim macro-inclusive PPA, power, FPS, end-to-end scheduling or a paper headline from this functional result.
